title: Three Months and One Short Stamp
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：territory　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 territory 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the clerk ① guarded the territory that no applicant in the office would have described, and he said the guarding was the whole of the month. The ② territory, meaning the land itself and not the stamp, ran three months and stayed undescribed in the book; a territory, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ territory in that office had the same short stamp beside it, and the ④ territory at the far counter, meaning the form they kept for the children to sign and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A territory, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the clerk said the describing is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the territory was the whole of the matter, meaning the right and not the land. The ⑥ territory, meaning the right and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; territory, he said, is either something you guard or the only word that means both a land and a right. He said the right is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ territory had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short stamp. The ⑧ territory of the whole thing, the clerk wrote in May, was one office and three months of describing; territory, he said, is either the form at the far counter or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ territory I remember is the land described in the file, which closed in 1977 and is still described as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ territory, my mother said in 1979, is the only land that improves by being described; every territory, she said, is a right that has agreed to look like a land. She said the right was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 领土；领域（指办事处里每一片旁边的那一片）
B. n. 领土；领域（指那片领土本身，与小小的印章相对）
C. 固定搭配：guard the territory 守卫这一片领土
D. n. 领土；领域（指留给孩子们签的那一份）
E. n. 领土之事（抽象总称，指一处办事处的领土之事）
F. n. 领土；领域（指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一片）
G. n. 领土、主权（指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 主权（抽象总称，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: guarded the territory that no applicant in the office would have described
The territory, meaning the land itself and not the stamp
the territory at the far counter
the territory was the whole of the matter
the territory had become a line in a file
The territory of the whole thing
A territory, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: guard the territory 意为“守卫这一片领土”，1970 年那位书记员把办事处里没有一位申请人肯描述的一片领土做了一遍。
territory 意为“领土；领域”，指那片领土本身而不是小小的印章，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被描述。
territory 意为“领土；领域”，指办事处里每一片旁边的那一片，每一片旁边都有同一枚小小的印章。
territory 意为“领土；领域”，指最远那个窗口的留给孩子们签的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
territory 意为“领土、主权”，指一件事里人人都办却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片主权就是那件事的全部。
territory 意为“主权”，指人人都办却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片领土，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
territory 意为“领土；领域”，指卷宗里写到、被描述的那一片，到 1975 年这一片成了卷宗里的一行。
territory 意为“领土之事”，书记员五月写道，整件事的领土之事是一处办事处和三个月份的描述。
territory 意为“领土；领域”，我记得的是卷宗里描述过的那一片，1977 年办结了，至今仍被说成办事处里最安静的一片。
territory 为抽象总称，母亲 1979 年说，领土是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的领土。
